{{Short description|Mathematical tool from spectral theory and functional analysis}}

The '''Helffer–Sjöstrand formula''' is a mathematical tool used in [[spectral theory]] and [[functional analysis]] to represent functions of [[self-adjoint operator|self-adjoint operators]]. Named after [[Bernard Helffer]] and [[Johannes Sjöstrand]], this formula provides a way to calculate functions of operators without requiring the operator to have a simple or explicitly known spectrum. It is especially useful in [[quantum mechanics]], [[condensed matter physics]], and other areas where understanding the properties of operators related to energy or observables is important.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Mbarek |first=Aiman |url=https://hal.science/hal-01163568/ |title=Helffer-Sjöstrand formula for Unitary Operators |date=June 2015 |publisher=[[HAL (open archive)]] |ref=hal-01163568}}</ref>

== Background ==

If <math> f \in C_c^\infty (\mathbb{R}) </math>, then we can find a function <math> \tilde f \in C_c^\infty (\mathbb{C}) </math> such that <math> \tilde{f}|_{\mathbb{R}} = f </math>, and for each <math> N \ge 0</math>, there exists a <math> C_N > 0</math> such that

<math> |\bar{\partial} \tilde{f}| \leq C_N |\operatorname{Im} z|^N. </math>

Such a function <math>\tilde{f} </math> is called an almost analytic extension of <math> f</math>.<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Dimassi |first1=M. |url=https://www.cambridge.org/core/books/spectral-asymptotics-in-the-semiclassical-limit/1E49D44B72B94C4ED55304A1C1CD7E9F |title=Spectral Asymptotics in the Semi-Classical Limit |last2=Sjostrand |first2=J. |date=1999 |publisher=Cambridge University Press |isbn=978-0-521-66544-5 |series=London Mathematical Society Lecture Note Series |location=Cambridge |doi=10.1017/CBO9780511662195}}</ref>

== The formula ==

If <math>f \in C_c^\infty(\mathbb{R})</math> and <math>A</math> is a self-adjoint operator on a Hilbert space, then

<math> f(A) = \frac{1}{\pi} \int_{\mathbb{C}} \bar{\partial} \tilde{f}(z) (z - A)^{-1} \, dx \, dy </math><ref>{{Cite book |last=Hörmander |first=Lars |author-link=Lars Hörmander |url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-642-61497-2 |title=The Analysis of Linear Partial Differential Operators I |date=1983 |publisher=[[Springer Nature]] |series=Classics in Mathematics |publication-date=2003 |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-3-642-61497-2|isbn=978-3-540-00662-6 }}</ref>

where <math> \tilde{f} </math> is an almost analytic extension of <math> f </math>, and <math> \bar{\partial}_z := \frac{1}{2}(\partial_{Re(z)} + i\partial_{Im(z)}) </math>.
